description_en: Compares the similarity between two faces by calling the CompareImageFaces operation
description_zh: 调用CompareImageFaces接口比较两个人脸的相似度
kebab_example: aliyun imm compare-image-faces --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --image-uri-a oss://imm-test/testcases/face1.jpg --image-uri-b oss://imm-test/testcases/face2.jpg --face-id-a 59edc040d0a8f4952b183d1b5044913a0ccd8739500ee2705ffe4965a0400000 --face-id-b b4a15b4f1618cdfa45a812974cfc160570052487ca1053e20bfdc12917e20000 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CompareImageFaces

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path.

This parameter is required when you compare face similarity by using the OSS URIs of two images
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径。


通过两张图片的OSS URI进行人脸相似度比较时，必须设置此参数
parameters.name: image_uri_a

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path.

parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: image_uri_b

parameters.help_en:
The face ID that already exists in the media set.

This parameter is required when you compare face similarity by using two face IDs from the media set
parameters.help_zh:
媒体集中已存在的人脸ID。

通过媒体集中的两个人脸ID进行人脸相似度比较时，必须设置此参数
